findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - CI runs the timing-inventory check for this change.
The repair adds two obsolete Node test IDs here, one browser-guidance ID at line 1547, and two full-run IDs at lines 1731–1732. The corresponding test functions now use `sixty` in their names (`tests/test_client_ci_time_limits.py:20`, `tests/test_fix_forge_says_end_to_end_tests_come_first_b.py:12`, and `tests/test_full_run_time_limits.py:18`). `tests/test_ci_timing_inventory.py:25–27` rejects timing keys absent from the collected suite, so the named timing proof and required tests check fail. Remove the five obsolete IDs.
findings.title: Remove obsolete 30-minute test IDs from the timing inventory

stop.reason: The finding is fixed: obsolete timing entries removed

why: A client's generated CI test job stops at 30 minutes, so a change that touches shared files and runs a large related set is cancelled with no output, while the nightly full run already allows 60
